## Addendum — the sonnet/bedrock failure family has TWO shapes, split by botocore version

Extends the previous comment. A second failure shape exists that my runs never hit, and the
`duration_s` field this ticket adds is what makes the two distinguishable by query rather than by
re-running:

- **Server-side, ~185s** — native structured output times out compiling the grammar. Seen here
  4x on `plan-review-prerequisite-verifier`, `requests=0`, sonnet-4-6. Degrades that one step.
- **Client-side, ~0.0s** — an OLDER botocore rejects the request before it is sent:
  `Parameter validation failed: Unknown parameter in input: "outputConfig"`. Independent of
  schema size, so it hits EVERY native call including trivial-class ones, and it fails silently.

**Measured version boundary on this host:**

    this worktree (.venv, provisioned by `make worktree`)  botocore 1.43.62
    main checkout /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.venv            botocore 1.40.61

**My recorded data confirms which side I was on** (73 calls, plan-review runs 3-5):

    failed calls with duration_s < 1.0s   : 0        <- no client-side rejects at all
    ticket-digest (722 B, trivial class)  : 4/4 OK, 6.1s / 6.9s / 6.7s / 7.2s, haiku-4-5

`ticket-digest` is exactly the call measured failing at 0.0s on botocore 1.40.61, and it
succeeded every time here. So the failure is **checkout-dependent, not ticket-dependent**: gates
run from the main checkout hit the silent client-side variant; gates run from a `make worktree`
worktree hit the 185s server-side one.

Practical consequence for anyone reading this ticket later: `make worktree` (which provisions a
fresh venv) is why this ticket's gate runs worked without any model-override stopgap. The real
fix for the main checkout is upgrading botocore, not only overriding the model class.

Credit: the two-shape split and the client-side reproduction are the coordinator's measurement on
rebar ticket 895c; recorded here because the previous comment would otherwise read as if ~185s
were the only failure mode.
